text: Aerospace and aeronautical science and technology integrates the achievements of numerous disciplines, including mathematics, mechanics, chemistry, power engineering and engineering thermophysics, materials science and engineering, mechanical engineering, and electronic science and technology. These disciplines have all played significant roles in its development. These disciplines intersect and permeate each other, forming a complete disciplinary system. At the same time, the development of the aerospace field will also promote the progress of related disciplines. Its research content is extensive, covering the design, manufacture, operation and use of aircraft, etc. The research results have had a significant impact on many sectors of the national economy and many aspects of social life, such as providing advanced means and conditions for transportation, communication and broadcasting, meteorology, etc. It also has important applications in the military field, promoting changes in military equipment and technology, etc.
